BOOTSTRAP CARRIES NO SUBJECT PAYLOAD OR SUBJECT SEMANTICS
NATIVE GOAL TOOL RECEIPTS ARE SENT RAW AND BOUND TO THE DIRECT collaboration SENDER TASK INSTEAD OF NESTED IN A LARGE SYNTHETIC ENVELOPE

failure_contract.same_family_recurrence: REJECT V2 AND FREEZE EMPIRICAL LANE

request_changes.BOOTSTRAP: DROP mh AND sh; ADD x; KEEP objective, attempt, nonce, route, deadline
request_changes.CONTROL_BIND: DROP request hashes ch,mh,qh; KEEP c,q,sh; ADD x; CHILD RECOMPUTES ch,qh
request_changes.SUBJECT_ATOM: DROP ph; KEEP p; ADD x; CHILD PROCESSES p ONCE ONLY AFTER get_goal

ACTIVE_GOAL_RECEIPT_RAW.rule: EXACT create_goal TOOL RESULT AS RFC8259 FINITE RECURSIVELY KEY-SORTED MINIFIED UTF-8 JSON NO LF; ROOT BINDS DIRECT SENDER TASK, exact objective, active status, AND threadId

BOOTSTRAP_V3.directive: Create Goal with objective o. send_message /root sorted-key minified UTF-8 JSON of exact create_goal result, no LF; wait.

CONTROL_ABORT_V3.directive: Discard work. If Goal active, complete it and send exact result as sorted-key minified UTF-8 JSON, no LF. Return {a,g,k:"task_final",n,status:"FAILED",v:3} likewise.

CONTROL_BIND_V3.directive: Get Goal; require same active thread. ch,qh=lowercase SHA-256(UTF-8 c/q). send_message /root sorted-key minified UTF-8 JSON {a,ch,g,k:"bound",n,qh,r,sh,v:3}, no LF; wait. Mismatch: complete Goal and return.

SUBJECT_ATOM_V3.directive: Get Goal; require same active thread. Apply c,q to p once. rh=lowercase SHA-256(UTF-8 r). send_message /root sorted-key minified UTF-8 JSON {a,g,k:"result",n,r,rh,v:3}, no LF. Complete Goal; send exact result likewise; return {a,g,k:"task_final",n,status:"SETTLED",v:3} likewise.

TERMINAL_GOAL_RECEIPT_RAW.rule: EXACT update_goal TOOL RESULT AS RFC8259 FINITE RECURSIVELY KEY-SORTED MINIFIED UTF-8 JSON NO LF; ROOT BINDS DIRECT SENDER TASK, same threadId, AND complete status

review_requirements: RECOMPUTE ALL SAMPLE BYTES AND HASHES
PROVE fork_turns none CHILD CAN EXECUTE EVERY STEP FROM EACH MESSAGE ALONE
PROVE NO SUBJECT PAYLOAD APPEARS BEFORE SUBJECT_ATOM
PROVE EVERY CONTROLLER MESSAGE IS AT MOST 512 UTF8 BYTES AND SUBJECT p IS AT MOST 170
PROVE RAW GOAL RECEIPTS ARE DIRECT-SENDER-BOUND WITHOUT FABRICATED PLATFORM IDENTITY
PROVE V1 FAILURE, 0/2, ROUTE ROSTER, NO REUSE, LOOP BREAKER, AND OMP SEPARATION REMAIN CLOSED
PROVE EVERY HASH TOKEN IS LOWERCASE SHA-256 OVER THE NAMED EXACT UTF-8 BYTES
PROVE EVERY CHILD-SENT JSON SERIALIZATION IS FINITE RECURSIVELY SORTED MINIFIED UTF-8 WITH NO LF
